docs.title: Survival (FM 21-76 / MCRP 3-02F)
docs.publisher: US Army and US Marine Corps
docs.about: The classic Army survival manual: psychology, planning, kits, shelter, water, fire, plants and animals for food, poisonous plants, dangerous animals, field-expedient tools, direction finding, signalling and crossing water.
docs.note: Superseded by later editions but still the most widely used. Copy kept by the Internet Archive.
